hints.title: Operator Precedence Cycling
hints.text: The operators cycle strictly in order: multiplication, division, addition, and subtraction. Multiplication and division take higher precedence than addition and subtraction.

hints.title: Simulate with Evaluation Buffer
hints.text: Maintain an evaluation list or buffer. When handling multiplication and division, immediately pop the top value, compute the integer result, and push it back.

hints.title: Signed Addition Accumulation
hints.text: For addition, push the operand directly. For subtraction, push the negative of the operand. At the end, summing all values in the buffer computes the correct total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating left-to-right without respecting operator precedence violates multiplication and division priority.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating the operations using a linear buffer consumes O(N) space and O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle operator cycling and integer division truncation towards zero properly.
complexity.notes: Can also be computed in O(1) math pattern by observing repeating modular cycles for N >= 5.
